summary: Implemented parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError in rdflib/extras/shacl.py, with tests in test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (42 tests). Nothing is committed. Not verified: black, isort, and mypy are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting, import order, and the type-check configuration were not run; line lengths were checked by hand (none over 88). Design choices: None and plain strings are rejected by widening the argument to object before the Node check (avoids None acting as a wildcard and avoids a mypy unreachable warning); BNode is not on the allowed import list, so it is not used; each modifier has its own branch passing "*", "+", or "?" literally to MulPath; a parametrized test covers valid and invalid shapes, and a separate test confirms the graph is unchanged after parsing.
